note: Dates up to 2026-10-25 were reconstructed from project discussions and screenshots. From 2026-10-26 the rows follow the git history of github.com/wrxminion/The-way-site. Only rows marked LIVE_VERIFIED were opened on the live site, on the date shown. IMPLEMENTED_PENDING_REVIEW and "Merged" mean the work is in the repository but a person has not yet checked the live page. Rows through D071 follow merged pull requests up to PR #54 (the members-only research tab is not listed). The IDs D038 and D040 were never used.

rows.title: Research observatory / case archive
rows.decision_or_proposal: Maintain source-rich investigative case inventory with uncertainty and opposing evidence
rows.why: A navigable historical case library supports ongoing research
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: Designed / some prototypes reported
rows.evidence_and_limits: Internal planning record; precise first implementation date unverified

rows.title: 50-state ballot map and plain-language voter information
rows.decision_or_proposal: Make ballots accessible by state with source-linked explanations and consequences
rows.why: Visitors need a practical entry point; map turns complex elections into local questions
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: Built and linked from the front page; a person has not yet compared every state page with its official sources
rows.evidence_and_limits: The repository holds 49 state guide folders and 50 state map folders besides Colorado. User reported the nationwide ballot map; do not claim every state's content has been checked by a person against official sources.

rows.title: Water/deep-blue homepage visual identity
rows.decision_or_proposal: Water-based transitions, darkening blue and spacious presentation
rows.why: Create coherent memorable identity without partisan symbolism
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: Design demonstrated in screenshot; deployment/version unverified
rows.evidence_and_limits: Screenshot-based report

rows.title: Nonpartisan Money Timeline and network
rows.decision_or_proposal: Connect donors, intermediaries, institutions, payments and policies
rows.why: Follow money with typed relationships and visible uncertainty
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: Built: the Money Timeline is in the repository and deployed; some money rows still need a record check
rows.evidence_and_limits: Five money rows are waiting for a check against the state campaign finance records (TRACER). Source money data is not necessarily complete.

rows.title: Preserve every source and historical revision
rows.decision_or_proposal: Record originals, capture time, hashes, edit history and corrections
rows.why: Links break and websites change; preserve reproducibility
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: Design requirement; per-source preservation requires verification
rows.evidence_and_limits: Do not label link-only source preserved

rows.title: Pull a Thread. Find its Way.
rows.decision_or_proposal: Backward-and-forward linked investigation from controversy to origins and consequences
rows.why: Consistent research navigation across civic topics
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: Accepted concept; site integration unverified
rows.evidence_and_limits: User approved methodology

rows.title: Five entrypoints: Map News Timeline Provenance Methods
rows.decision_or_proposal: Expose five views of shared evidence database
rows.why: Different audiences need distinct starting points, not siloed datasets
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: Superseded by D018: the header and front page now carry four destinations. LIVE_VERIFIED 2026-10-26 under D018.
rows.evidence_and_limits: The five-entrypoint design was replaced by four destinations on 2026-10-26; see D018 for what was opened on the live site.

rows.title: Two-Minute Rule
rows.origin: Public Reddit discussion and project response
rows.decision_or_proposal: Visitors find a meaningful finding, see evidence and choose next connection within 120 seconds
rows.why: Avoid massive unreadable vote lists; progressive disclosure
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: Accepted requirement; usability tests pending
rows.evidence_and_limits: Anonymous Reddit commenter, identity withheld

rows.title: First-paragraph hook and visual explanation
rows.decision_or_proposal: Every article opens with substance and question; graphics explain before deep dive
rows.why: Engage quickly without sacrificing rigor
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: Accepted editorial requirement; no shared page template for it exists in the repository yet
rows.evidence_and_limits: Applied to pages one at a time by a person. Never sensationalize beyond evidence.

rows.title: Expectation Gap / within-supporter context
rows.decision_or_proposal: Compare official with own campaign promises, party peers and constituent priorities
rows.why: Generic party alignment reveals little; notable departures are useful
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: Design exploration, not launched
rows.evidence_and_limits: Requires defensible peer and polling baselines

rows.title: Public Development Ledger
rows.decision_or_proposal: Track proposal, rationale, alternatives, decision, credit, review, implementation and evidence
rows.why: Apply Institute accountability principles to its own development
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: Specification accepted; publication pending
rows.evidence_and_limits: Contributor privacy and consent important

rows.title: Religion Freedom and Power timeline linked to Money Timeline
rows.decision_or_proposal: Historic beliefs/institutions/policy/finance linked through shared evidence graph
rows.why: Use one system to trace ideas and material impacts
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: Research packets created; Claude integration pending
rows.evidence_and_limits: Do not conflate coincidental links with causality

rows.title: AI-use transparency brief
rows.decision_or_proposal: Explain AI research, writing, design, extraction and review roles; human accountability
rows.why: Trust requires disclosing AI capabilities and limits
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: Documented policy; public implementation pending
rows.evidence_and_limits: No claim every result was verified by a human

rows.title: State change only after verified implementation
rows.decision_or_proposal: Ledger remains proposed/accepted/in-progress until Claude deploys and verification occurs; then label live
rows.why: Prevent planned concepts masquerading as shipped features
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: Approved rule; ledger machinery not yet built
rows.evidence_and_limits: Live means deployed and independently smoke-tested

rows.title: What People Do section becomes an accessible accordion
rows.decision_or_proposal: Collapsed by default, whole title row is one button, keyboard and screen-reader support, honors reduced motion
rows.why: Keep the page short without hiding the ballot link or evidence
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: Built and browser-tested in isolation; not deployed; the section itself was not found in the site copy available, so placement is unverified
rows.evidence_and_limits: Tested at 320 to 1280 px. Not yet checked on Pixel Fold or a screen reader. Not live.

rows.title: Candidate profile first-screen redesign
rows.decision_or_proposal: Compact identity line, In their own words first, office description and background collapsed below
rows.why: The first screen should say what the person says they will do
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: Built as an enhancement script; not deployed; not live
rows.evidence_and_limits: Tested on one generated page (Minnesota governor race) with 0, 2 and 4 statements. Candidate facts were not changed or verified. No Evidence Profile counts exist in the data yet.

rows.title: Retire the Michi score
rows.decision_or_proposal: Replace any composite candidate score with source-backed Evidence Profiles
rows.why: Composite scores need subjective weights and hide contested judgments
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: Approved; no score was found on the site copies checked
rows.evidence_and_limits: Evidence Profile counts (votes, funding) are not built. Legal review is required before election-oriented candidate profiles.

rows.title: Site search
rows.origin: Frank, Oct 26 2026, via the project coordinator; librarian meeting feedback as reported by Frank
rows.decision_or_proposal: A search page over 5,662 site pages with section, type, place and year filters, a plain reason for each match, and outside search links for Ballotpedia, Science.gov and CQ Researcher.
rows.why: The librarian asked for search inside Michi and help searching outside research databases.
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: LIVE_VERIFIED 2026-10-26 in Chrome (header, one search with filters).
rows.evidence_and_limits: Searches titles, short descriptions, headings, places and years, not full text. Science.gov does not take a query in its link, so it gets a Copy query button. CQ Researcher needs a library login. Saving a found source to a review queue is not built.

rows.title: News ingestion, tagging and backfill
rows.origin: Frank, Oct 26 2026, via the project coordinator; librarian meeting feedback as reported by Frank
rows.decision_or_proposal: A 50-state collector, tagging of candidates, statewide measures and 222 local measures from the guide pages on every run, a private append-only archive, two scheduled tasks on a private workstation (every 2 hours, and a weekly check), and a monthly backfill walking back to Jan 1 2026 and then further.
rows.why: The public feed had gone stale after Oct 17 because the earlier process was manual.
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: IMPLEMENTED_PENDING_REVIEW. Scheduled runs every 2 hours have committed to the repository since 2026-10-26. The backfill to 2026-01-01 finished for all states on 2026-10-27; a deeper pass toward May 2025 is still running.
rows.evidence_and_limits: The public feed shows the newest 200 per state and 3,000 overall; the private archive keeps everything collected. 225 local measures have no usable ballot code and are not tagged. No article text or page copies are kept for news yet. The deeper pass stops by itself when a round adds fewer than 200 items. One Maine error is covered by a later pass. A person has not yet checked two full scheduled cycles end to end.

rows.title: Evidence vault for cited sources
rows.origin: Frank, Oct 26 2026, via the project coordinator; librarian meeting feedback as reported by Frank
rows.decision_or_proposal: A private store of dated copies of cited sources with SHA-256, a Wayback copy where allowed, a screenshot, and text or OCR, with a provenance record per source and a "not yet verified by a person" default.
rows.why: Frank asked for proof copies of government documents, especially old scans, with more than one provenance.
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: IMPLEMENTED_PENDING_REVIEW. Built and run on the sources the TABOR study cites; nothing here is public.
rows.evidence_and_limits: Respects robots.txt: the state host for the 1992 and 2005 scans disallows automated download, so those were recorded as blocked and second hosts at the University of Denver are being used. OCR is machine text, unproofed. No record has been verified by a person yet.
